prompt: Edit this image. Keep the backlit house sign in the centre exactly as it is: the same brushed-aluminium elevation frame, the same oil-paint brushwork flowing from signal red through blush to lilac, the same soft halo, the same thin drafting guideline above the roof apex, same position, size and proportions. Include precise construction geometry in finer lines: compass arcs, centre marks, radial guides and a few dimension ticks. Add only a few very soft translucent washes of blush pink and pale lilac behind parts of the weave. Composition is symmetrical and balanced around the sign, drawing darker and clearer than a light sketch yet still clearly secondary to the luminous painted sign, with breathing room at the edges. Same soft diffused daylight, same straight-on view, hyperrealistic charcoal-on-concrete texture. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
